parsed.why: Five-year-minimum sodomy/gross-indecency statute (largely unenforced but available as a lever), documented police harassment, 93% hostile neighbour attitudes, no recourse or LGBT infrastructure, no trans-specific evidence either way. Severe societal hostility with thin remedy.

No criminalisation, no documented police or border targeting of trans people, one locally accepted third-gender community; deficits are resident-facing (surgery-based recognition, no anti-discrimination/hate-crime law). Thin data but documented non-hostility.

Enforced prohibition law with raids, torture, extortion for 'looking gay'; death-penalty risk in 12 northern states; unprosecuted trans killing with police misgendering; discretionary prison placement; app-based blackmail gangs. State-tolerated targeting.

No criminalisation, but documented refusal of medical care including hormones and general treatment, hiring discrimination singling out trans people, unpunished lynchings, police non-response and fear of reporting. Universal service denial without working remedy.

Decriminalised by 2022 court ruling reading sex discrimination to cover gender identity; no trans-specific offences, no documented targeting or violence pattern; gaps are resident-facing recognition and absent statutory protections. Functioning courts working for rights.
